title: Configurable range views
symptom: The user requests a setting to configure how many hours in the past the BG curve is displayed, similar to Nightscout's 3, 6, 12, and 24 hour views.
fix: Long press on the xDrip icon on the app home screen to enable time buttons, then long press on a time button to lock the view to that time period.
evidence_quote: IF you long press on the xDrip icon on the app home screen you can enable time buttons. If you long press on a time button you can lock the view to that time period.
